story: It is breakfast. Sam is in the kitchen.
Sam has bread and an egg.
Anna says, Can I have some juice?
Sam gives Anna the juice and an apple.
They eat and drink. They are happy.
chant: Egg, egg, I like an egg.
Apple, juice and cake for me!

story: Grace has a new house.
There is a big kitchen.
There is a table and four chairs.
Grace is in her bedroom.
There is a bed and a blue lamp.
She says, I love my home!
chant: I love my home, my home!

story: Tom is in the garden.
The sun is big and yellow.
There is a bird in the tree.
A bee is on a red flower.
Tom plays with his ball.
He is very happy.
Ben and Lucy are at the park.
Ben kicks the football.
Lucy runs and catches the ball.
Lucy throws the ball to Ben.
Ben can jump. Lucy can swim.
They play and have fun.
chant: Kick the ball, one, two, three.
Catch the ball, throw the ball.

story: Kim is on the street with Dad.
She sees a red bus.
She sees a car and a blue bike.
The bus stops. Kim and Dad go to school.
Kim waves to the bus.
She likes the bus.
chant: Bus, bus, a big red bus.
Car, car, a small blue car.
Look at the street with me!
